profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Chad Ross 👋
I am a software engineer and IT specialist who bridges the gap between secure code and reliable infrastructure. With over 7 years of hands-on experience spanning computer systems repair, software development, and technical customer service, I thrive on breaking down complex technical problems and building resilient, scalable solutions.

My background combines a deep understanding of hardware and systems diagnostics with modern full-stack development. Whether I am architecting applications, optimizing system performance, or analyzing security postures, I approach every project with an analytical, defense-in-depth mindset.

Explore my portfolio, technical logs, and recent projects at: chadross.dev

honors.title: Highest-Ranked Two-Year College
honors.description:
In the 2016 Southern California Regional qualification round of the International Collegiate Programming Challenge, I was a member of team *NULL, which was the highest-ranked team in the two-year college division, coming in 22nd overall.

The ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) is a team-based, programming competition, sponsored by IBM and headquartered at Baylor University. Teams of 3 are given a packet of 10 problems and must write programs to solve as many of the problems as possible in 5 hours. The teams submit their code and an automated system runs it, supplying input data that is unknown to the teams and compares the program output to the expected result. My team used a combination of Python and C++ for our solutions and solved 5 of 10 problems, a record for the two-year division.

http://socalcontest.org/history/2016/details-2016.shtml
